list.name: strategy
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT strategy FROM signal_outcomes ORDER BY 1
list.label: Strategy

list.name: symbol
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' ORDER BY 1
list.label: Symbol

list.name: timeframe
list.label: Timeframe
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT timeframe FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Unrealized PnL
panels.description: expected_direction × (current_price − entry_price) / entry_price. Entry = price at signal firing.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_signal AS (
  SELECT signal_ts, signal_value,
    (SELECT close FROM ohlcv WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS current_close,
    (SELECT close FROM ohlcv WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' AND ts <= s.signal_ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS signal_price
  FROM signal_outcomes s
  WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='sim'
  ORDER BY signal_ts DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT $expected_direction * (current_close - signal_price) / NULLIF(signal_price, 0) AS "PnL"
FROM latest_signal
WHERE current_close IS NOT NULL AND signal_price IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Mean Fwd Return (T+$n)
panels.description: expected_direction × AVG(forward return over n bars). Positive = edge aligned with expected direction.

targets.rawSql:
WITH fwd AS (
  SELECT (exit_bar.close - entry_bar.close) / NULLIF(entry_bar.close, 0) AS ret
  FROM signal_outcomes s
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT close FROM ohlcv
    WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' AND ts <= s.signal_ts
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
  ) entry_bar ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT close FROM ohlcv
    WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' AND ts > s.signal_ts
    ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1 OFFSET ($n - 1)
  ) exit_bar ON true
  WHERE s.strategy='$strategy' AND s.symbol='$symbol' AND s.source='sim'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.signal_ts)
)
SELECT $expected_direction * AVG(ret) AS "Mean Ret" FROM fwd

panels.title: Edge Ratio (T+$n)
panels.description: AVG(MFE) / AVG(MAE) over n bars. MFE = max favorable excursion from entry, MAE = max adverse excursion from entry. >2 = healthy, <1 = adverse exceeds favorable.

targets.rawSql:
WITH exc AS (
  SELECT exc.mfe, exc.mae
  FROM signal_outcomes s
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT close AS entry_close FROM ohlcv
    WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' AND ts <= s.signal_ts
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
  ) entry_bar ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      MAX((b.high - entry_bar.entry_close) / NULLIF(entry_bar.entry_close, 0)) AS mfe,
      MAX((entry_bar.entry_close - b.low) / NULLIF(entry_bar.entry_close, 0)) AS mae
    FROM (
      SELECT high, low FROM ohlcv
      WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' AND ts > s.signal_ts
      ORDER BY ts LIMIT $n
    ) b
  ) exc ON true
  WHERE s.strategy='$strategy' AND s.symbol='$symbol' AND s.source='sim'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.signal_ts)
)
SELECT AVG(mfe) / NULLIF(AVG(mae), 0) AS "Edge" FROM exc

panels.title: Last Signal Age
panels.description: Hours since last signal. >48hr may indicate system failure or regime change.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - MAX(signal_ts)) / 3600.0 AS "Age" FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='sim'

panels.title: N (Signals)
panels.description: Total signal count in selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "N" FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='sim' AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts)

panels.title: Signal Value
panels.description: Latest signal_value. Boolean signals = always 1. Continuous signals = model output magnitude.

targets.rawSql: SELECT signal_value AS "Value" FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='sim' ORDER BY signal_ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Timeframe
panels.description: Signal monitoring frequency. Derived from signal_outcomes.

panels.title: Price & Signals
panels.description: Price (left axis) with signal firing points (right axis, orange dots).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, close AS "Close"
FROM ohlcv
WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe'
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts

SELECT signal_ts AS time, signal_value AS "Signal"
FROM signal_outcomes
WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='sim'
  AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts)
ORDER BY signal_ts

panels.title: Cumulative Signal Return (T+$n)
panels.description: Cumulative expected_direction × forward return over n bars. Pure signal edge accumulation — no position sizing, slippage, or fees.

targets.rawSql:
WITH fwd AS (
  SELECT s.signal_ts,
    (exit_bar.close - entry_bar.close) / NULLIF(entry_bar.close, 0) AS ret
  FROM signal_outcomes s
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT close FROM ohlcv
    WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' AND ts <= s.signal_ts
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
  ) entry_bar ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT close FROM ohlcv
    WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' AND ts > s.signal_ts
    ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1 OFFSET ($n - 1)
  ) exit_bar ON true
  WHERE s.strategy='$strategy' AND s.symbol='$symbol' AND s.source='sim'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.signal_ts)
)
SELECT signal_ts AS time,
  SUM($expected_direction * ret) OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts) AS "Cumulative Return"
FROM fwd
ORDER BY signal_ts

panels.title: Rolling $k Mean Return (T+$n)
panels.description: Rolling k-signal average of expected_direction × forward return over n bars. Declining trend = signal edge weakening.

targets.rawSql:
WITH fwd AS (
  SELECT s.signal_ts,
    $expected_direction * (exit_bar.close - entry_bar.close) / NULLIF(entry_bar.close, 0) AS adj_return,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.signal_ts) AS rn
  FROM signal_outcomes s
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT close FROM ohlcv
    WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' AND ts <= s.signal_ts
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
  ) entry_bar ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT close FROM ohlcv
    WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' AND ts > s.signal_ts
    ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1 OFFSET ($n - 1)
  ) exit_bar ON true
  WHERE s.strategy='$strategy' AND s.symbol='$symbol' AND s.source='sim'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.signal_ts)
)
SELECT signal_ts AS time,
  AVG(adj_return) OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts ROWS BETWEEN ($k - 1) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Mean Return"
FROM fwd
WHERE rn >= $k
ORDER BY signal_ts

panels.title: Rolling $k Edge Ratio (T+$n)
panels.description: Rolling k-signal AVG(MFE) / AVG(MAE) over n bars. >2 = healthy, <1 = adverse exceeds favorable.

targets.rawSql:
WITH exc AS (
  SELECT s.signal_ts, exc.mfe, exc.mae,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.signal_ts) AS rn
  FROM signal_outcomes s
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT close AS entry_close FROM ohlcv
    WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' AND ts <= s.signal_ts
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
  ) entry_bar ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      MAX((b.high - entry_bar.entry_close) / NULLIF(entry_bar.entry_close, 0)) AS mfe,
      MAX((entry_bar.entry_close - b.low) / NULLIF(entry_bar.entry_close, 0)) AS mae
    FROM (
      SELECT high, low FROM ohlcv
      WHERE symbol='$symbol' AND timeframe='$timeframe' AND ts > s.signal_ts
      ORDER BY ts LIMIT $n
    ) b
  ) exc ON true
  WHERE s.strategy='$strategy' AND s.symbol='$symbol' AND s.source='sim'
    AND $__timeFilter(s.signal_ts)
)
SELECT signal_ts AS time,
  AVG(mfe) OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts ROWS BETWEEN ($k - 1) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
  / NULLIF(AVG(mae) OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts ROWS BETWEEN ($k - 1) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0)
  AS "Edge Ratio"
FROM exc
WHERE rn >= $k
ORDER BY signal_ts
